data.one_liner: Comprehensive client library for the AT Protocol supporting records, identity, and the firehose.
data.what_it_does: Provides complete coverage of the com.atproto namespace for Dart and Flutter. Enables repository management, session-based and OAuth authentication, and real-time data streaming via the Firehose API.
use_when: Building decentralized social applications or clients for Bluesky
Interacting with AT Protocol services, repositories, and identity management
Consuming real-time data streams from the AT Protocol firehose
avoid_when: Working with other backend ecosystems like Firebase or Supabase instead of AT Protocol
Needing general-purpose HTTP requests without AT Protocol semantics
strengths: Complete coverage of all com.atproto endpoints and services
Built-in robust retry logic, exponential backoff, and durable cursor management
Supports both session-based authentication and OAuth DPoP
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the AT Protocol ecosystem
Requires careful state management of cursor storage for high-throughput firehose consumers
